notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Nintendo Switch only, so there is no Steam app. StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0: only Controls and Table of Contents are written. Its Walkthrough, Gameplay, Enemies, Outfits, Luigi's Balloon World and all 17 kingdom pages are linked but not written, so it is not a usable guide. The chapter names and order come from the kingdom page names on its contents page (CC BY-SA 4.0, names only); the grouping into chapters and the summaries are our own, and where the story ends was not in the data, so the later chapter breaks simply follow the list order. mario.fandom.com answers the API under "Super Mario Odyssey" with 500 linked articles (the query limit, so possibly more); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
